tests.requirement: User can log in to system
tests.title: Login Success

steps.step: Enter valid username and password
Click the login button

tests.expected_result: System logs user in successfully

tests.title: Invalid Login Attempt

steps.step: Enter invalid username and password
Click the login button

tests.expected_result: System displays an error message for invalid login attempt

tests.requirement: User can search patient by name
tests.title: Patient Search by Name

steps.step: Enter a valid patient name in the search bar
Click the search button

tests.expected_result: System displays a list of matching patients

tests.requirement: User can search patient by SSN
tests.title: Patient Search by SSN

steps.step: Enter a valid patient SSN in the search bar
Click the search button

tests.expected_result: System displays a list of matching patients

tests.title: Open Patient Profile

steps.step: Search for a valid patient and click on their profile

tests.expected_result: System displays the patient's profile information

tests.title: View Patient Demographics

steps.step: Click on the 'Demographics' tab in the patient profile

tests.expected_result: System displays the patient's demographic information

tests.requirement: User can view patient visit history
tests.title: View Patient Visit History

steps.step: Click on the 'Visit History' tab in the patient profile

tests.expected_result: System displays a list of the patient's past visits

tests.title: Open Encounter Record

steps.step: Click on a specific visit in the patient's visit history

tests.expected_result: System displays the encounter record information

tests.title: View Medical History

steps.step: Click on the 'Medical History' tab in the patient profile

tests.expected_result: System displays a list of the patient's past medical events

tests.title: View Prescriptions

steps.step: Click on the 'Prescriptions' tab in the patient profile

tests.expected_result: System displays a list of the patient's current and past prescriptions

tests.title: Add Clinical Notes

steps.step: Click on the 'Add Note' button in the patient's encounter record

tests.expected_result: System allows user to add a new clinical note

tests.title: Prescribe Medication
tests.preconditions: Patient profile is open and patient has no active prescriptions

steps.step: Click on the 'Prescribe' button in the patient's profile

tests.expected_result: System allows user to prescribe a new medication for the patient

tests.title: Allergy Checking
tests.preconditions: Patient profile is open and patient has allergies recorded

steps.step: Click on the 'Allergies' tab in the patient's profile

tests.expected_result: System displays a list of the patient's recorded allergies

tests.title: Appointment Overview
tests.preconditions: Patient profile is open and patient has upcoming appointments scheduled

steps.step: Click on the 'Appointments' tab in the patient's profile

tests.expected_result: System displays a list of the patient's upcoming appointments

tests.title: Patient Access Control

steps.step: Log in as a patient and attempt to access restricted information

tests.expected_result: System denies patient access to restricted information

tests.title: Logout Success

steps.step: Click the logout button

tests.expected_result: System logs user out successfully

tests.requirement: User can log in to system
tests.title: Login Success (Workflow)

steps.step: Enter valid username and password
Click the login button

tests.expected_result: System logs user in successfully and displays the patient's profile information

tests.title: Logout Success (Error Handling)

steps.step: Click the logout button while attempting to access a restricted page

tests.expected_result: System displays an error message and denies user access to the restricted page

tests.requirement: User can log in to system
tests.title: Login Success (Edge Case)

steps.step: Enter a valid username with an unusual character sequence
Click the login button

tests.expected_result: System logs user in successfully and displays the patient's profile information

tests.title: Logout Success (Edge Case)

steps.step: Click the logout button while attempting to access a restricted page with an unusual character sequence

tests.expected_result: System displays an error message and denies user access to the restricted page
